thread:
inc-bot: PagerDuty alert: geo-dns: High SERVFAIL rate from EU resolvers for *.redwood.ai (P1)
inc-bot: Auto-paging on-call: @dave (oncall) — please acknowledge within 2m
dave (oncall): acknowledged, looking now.
ben (netops): seeing similar from our external probes — spikes from eu-west-1+eu-central-1. Traces show NXDOMAIN->SERVFAIL transitions.
alice (sre): confirming customer reports of elevated 5xxs for hosted api in EU. Not wide but several accounts hitting latency/timeouts.
nancy (prod): got a ticket from a mid-market customer in Frankfurt, they see intermittent DNS failures causing client reconnection loops.
carla (platform): I pulled historical dig checks — there's a mismatch on delegation NS between Route53 and Cloudflare edge. Could be partial propagation.
ben (netops): past 5m dig output from 3 resolvers (abridged):
```
; <<>> DiG 9.11.3 <<>> +trace api.redwood.ai @8.8.8.8
;; ->>HEADER<<- opcode: QUERY, status: SERVFAIL, id: 12345
;; flags: qr rd ra; QUERY: 1, ANSWER: 0, AUTHORITY: 1, ADDITIONAL: 1
;; AUTHORITY SECTION:
redwood.ai.  60 IN SOA ns-1.route53.example. hostmaster.redwood.ai. 2024031501 7200 900 1209600 60
```
carla (platform): And from a Cloudflare probe:
```
; <<>> DiG 9.10.6 <<>> api.redwood.ai @1.1.1.1
;; ->>HEADER<<- opcode: QUERY, status: NOERROR
;; ANSWER: api.redwood.ai. 300 IN A 10.1.1.2
;; but NS delegation returned an old set (missing secondary-route53) causing inconsistent resolver behaviour
```
alice (sre): TL;DR: some resolvers see Route53 NS set, others see stale Cloudflare NS set -> inconsistent authoritative responses -> SERVFAILs under load. Likely TTL/proper delegation mismatch after last night's DNS change.
ben (netops): I can reproduce delegated NS mismatch: route53 shows ns1/2.redwood.net, cloudflare shows ns-old.redwood.net. Looks like the registrar delegation wasn't updated fully.
dave (oncall): who made the DNS change overnight? @carla? @route53-bot any change events?
route53-bot: Change batch 987654 applied 2024-03-14 02:12 UTC — updated A records for api.redwood.ai. No NS change recorded.
carla (platform): I rolled a config that updated GeoDNS rules 03:58 UTC but didn't touch zone delegation at registrar. However, a partner script attempted automated registrar sync at 04:15 and retried until 04:22 — logs show intermittent failures. Could be partial write to registrar and propagation mismatch.
alice (sre): Impact classification: partial DNS resolution failures in EU causing client errors and increased retries. Not global outage but customer-visible errors for EU-heavy customers. P1 for impacted customers.
ben (netops): Immediate mitigation options:
- revert registrar delegation to previous NS set (requires registrar auth, 5-15m to propagate)
- update GeoDNS to accept both NS sets via aliasing (short-term hack)
- add short TTL override on apex + ensure all authoritative servers consistent (but registrar is the blocker)
dave (oncall): I can do a temporary traffic-level mitigation: add origin fallback at proxy for EU, route to healthy edge if DNS fails. That's a bandaid.
carla (platform): I'll open support ticket with registrar and escalate to on-call contacts. Doing that now — holding for auth code.
carla (platform): registrar support case #REG-5421 opened, marked urgent. Estimated 30-60m depending on validation.
nancy (prod): Notify customers? We should post a short status: "Intermittent DNS failures affecting EU users; engineering investigating". I'll draft the notice.
alice (sre): In parallel: ben, can you run continuous dig+trace from EU probes and post logs here every 2m? I'll merge with app telemetry.
ben (netops): started probes, posting diffs in thread. First batch: 6/10 probes show delegation to ns-old.redwood.net, 4/10 show ns-route53. TTLs range from 60-3600s.
dave (oncall): Implementing proxy fallback for EU now — will route repeated unresolved requests to regional fallback cluster. May add ~20-30ms latency for affected flows.
carla (platform): Registrar responded: need additional verification (org contact). Escalating to legal + security for confirmation. ETA 20m to respond.
route53-bot: Notifying: health-checks for resolvers show elevated error rates — auto-failover not triggered due to conflicting authoritative answers.
alice (sre): Running quick smoke: can we push a temporary short TTL (60s) on the zone apex via Route53 so when registrar finishes propagation, caches clear faster? Route53 accepts changes but if registrar has mismatched delegation, might still be ignored by some resolvers.
ben (netops): change applied to Route53: SOA serial bumped. TTLs set to 60 where possible.
carla (platform): registrar auth completed, they will apply delegation update in 2-5m. We'll watch for NS convergence.
between: 1745554500 - 1745554620 (automated probe posts)
ben (netops): probe update @1745554560: 9/10 resolvers now returning Route53 NS set. SERVFAIL rate dropping.
alice (sre): app 5xx errors down 70% in EU traffic. Rolling back proxy fallback in 10m once we confirm stable.
dave (oncall): keep page open until 30m stable window. I'm keeping monitoring dashboards open.
nancy (prod): Sent status update to customers: short note + "we've implemented mitigations and are monitoring; root cause: partial registrar delegation during automated sync; CRE next steps: registrar escalation + improved automation checks".
carla (platform): Follow-up action items for post-incident:
- require manual confirmation step for registrar delegation changes (prevent partial writes)
- tighten automation retries and add validation probes post-change
- add runbook for GeoDNS registrar mismatch
- review partner sync scripts and rotate auth keys
alice (sre): timeline capture for SevDoc:
- 03:58 UTC config change (GeoDNS rules)
- 04:15 UTC partner registrar sync attempted (partial)
- 04:22 UTC initial customer errors seen in EU
- 04:30 UTC PagerDuty page/incident declared
- 04:35 UTC route53 TTL override applied
- 04:40 UTC registrar verification completed; delegation corrected
- 04:47 UTC probes show ~90% convergence to route53 NS
- 05:10 UTC stable window observed, mitigation being removed
dave (oncall): acknowledging handoff to daytime SRE rotation @1745554760 — leaving notes for the oncoming shift.
carla (platform): I'll create the incident ticket and backlog tasks. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
route53-bot: Change 987654 closed.
inc-bot: Incident resolved from P1 to P2 (customer impact reduced).
